subject: Quarterly alignment: renewal sprint, exec window & QBR scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@novaprod.com>, Adam Feldman <adam.f@novaprod.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarterly alignment: renewal sprint, exec window & QBR scheduling

Hi Sarah / Adam —

Congrats on the momentum this quarter — usage has been strong and the team flagged a few asks we should lock into the renewal conversation (term length flexibility, staged capacity uplift, and SLA add-on options). I want to get a short renewal sprint started so we can:

- Confirm capacity runway and any uplift by product area
- Align on term & pricing guardrails (annual vs. 3-year tradeoffs)
- Schedule a QBR/executive window to present the mutual action plan and get sign-off

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll attach a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a QBR prep checklist — please review by Fri 9/4
2) Can you share 2 exec slots (30–45m) the week of 9/14 for an SLA + exec review? We prefer 9/15 or 9/16 afternoon PT, but flexible
3) Lets nominate internal owners: NovaProd owner for capacity estimates + procurement contact for contract redlines

I’ve cc’d Logan (renewals lead) and Ben (sales engineering) — they’ll own technical run-rate and uplift sizing. Monica is on account success and will coordinate QBR logistics.

Attachments: NovaProd_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf, QBR-Prep-Checklist.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@novaprod.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Adam Feldman <adam.f@novaprod.com>, procurement@novaprod.com, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly alignment: renewal sprint, exec window & QBR scheduling

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan. We can do the week of 9/14. Tentative executive availability:
- Tue 9/15 14:00–14:45 PT
- Wed 9/16 15:00–15:45 PT

I’ll confirm by EOD Friday after checking calendars.

On owners: I’ll be the internal owner for product/usage sizing; looping in Adam for procurement/redlines. Procurement alias is included.

Quick notes on priorities from our side:
- We want the option for a staggered capacity uplift (start +25% Q1, +25% Q3) rather than a single large uplift
- Would like pricing examples for annual vs. 3-year term (with and without SLA)

Please send any prep artifacts and a short agenda for the exec window so I can route to our CTO and Head of Ops.

—Sarah
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Product, NovaProd Inc.
sarah@novaprod.com | +1 212-555-0199

Thanks Sarah — appreciate the quick reply and the priority list.

I’ve updated the MAP to include the staggered uplift option and sketched two pricing scenarios (annual vs. 3-year) — see attached NovaProd_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf. Quick agenda for the exec window (30–45m):
- 5m: Executive alignment & outcomes
- 10m: Usage & capacity runway (Logan)
- 10m: Renewal terms & pricing scenarios (Marissa)
- 10m: SLA add-on + SLO expectations (Ben)
- 10m: Next steps / decision milestones (all)

Ben — can you confirm the SLA tiers we can realistically commit to for the proposed uplift? I want a crisp ask for the execs.

Logan — please prepare a one-page capacity summary (current token run-rate, peak percentiles, KV cache footprint, and any expected seasonal spikes) — we’ll need it attached to the MAP for the CTO.

Sarah — once you confirm the slot, Monica will send a calendar invite + meeting brief. If procurement wants a separate redline window earlier, we can schedule a 20m contract sync next week.

Best,
—Marissa

Looping in a short SLA note —

For the staged uplift you outlined we can offer these realistic commitments:
- Standard SLA (99.5% availability) — included with annual or 3-year term
- Premium SLA (99.9% availability + faster support RTO) — add-on fee scoped by committed throughput; rough estimate: +8–12% on list price for the first year at +50% commit, scaled down if staggered uplift

I’ll prepare a 1-slide SLA tradeoff matrix for the exec deck. Also: there’s a procurement nuance — multi-year discounts require a PO/contract signature by the close of the quarter to secure pricing bands.

Marissa — recommend we propose Tue 9/15 14:00 PT as the primary exec slot and Wed 9/16 15:00 PT as alternate. Monica — if you can draft the invite & attach the MAP, we’re good to go.

—Ben
